evidence: The punch's search pass left the planes H = n ± 1/3 ± 0.08 r.l.u. alone on every dataset by default (search_exclude_h_fractions = (0.3333, 0.6667), src/nebula3d/pipeline.py:546, applied to every image of H, src/nebula3d/analysis/bragg.py:2333-2364): a fact about one kind of sample made the default for all. A sharp spurious peak there, on a sample with no satellites, was neither punched nor, since D5, counted against the punch (web/src/llm/tune/evaluate.ts:267, web/src/llm/verdicts/rules.ts:255). The console kept a second implementation of the same planes: the leftover marks read the Configure form (web/src/llm/context/loadContext.ts:31, whose default is the exact 1/3 and 2/3 where the backend's is rounded to 1e-4, web/src/state/pipelineStore.ts:431; web/src/llm/metrics/punch.ts:181), not the run, so they could differ from what the run's search left alone. The protection named fractional H planes only: no modulation off H, no satellites as points, no parent lattice of a doubled cell. peak_profile.magnetic_satellite_centers assumed the thirds too (src/nebula3d/analysis/peak_profile.py:596).
proposed_fix: Protection follows the sample's modulation, a fact declared per material beside its symmetry (PipelineParams.modulation; a request's modulation): its k vectors, order, form and half width. As points, the satellites G ± m·R·k (R over the point group), each in a box; as planes, t·x ≡ ±m·(k·t) (mod P) through them, t along k. Both are on the parent lattice of the punch's cell and closed under the symmetry, and read one predicate for the mask, the console's marks, D5, the guard and the validation (nebula3d.modulation). Nothing is protected by default. The punch records what its search left alone and measures whether its sharp peaks off the lattice bunch at one commensurate fraction (a binomial tail, family-wise at 1.35e-3 over coordinates × denominators the grid resolves, at least three hits); when they do, the Pilot asks the user. In three pull requests: P1, the Python module and its adapters, behaviour-neutral, its default today's planes declared as k = (1/3, 0, 0) in plane form, bit for bit; P2, the web and the Pilot; P3, the default becomes none.

note: Decided by the user, 2026-10-19: nothing is protected by default; protection follows a modulation declared per material, in a form the user declares; when a run's sharp peaks off the lattice bunch at one commensurate fraction, the Pilot asks. Design B with three parts of design A (the guard reads only sharp peaks and needs three hits; tests/test_symmetry.py names the thirds it relied on), approved by the manager on the user's delegation the same day. P1, behaviour-neutral, in d9e236a, 3b1b202, 95e168e, b774f82, 7e2d340, 47ff7e2 and 260fc68, with this entry: on every dev case at n = 81 and n = 161 the rings and punch stages are bit for bit as main's (the volume, the holes, the profile and the log), and the bunching test fires on none. Arm A on dev re-run on the final head: 32 of 32 entries identical, 5 of 8 cases pass, as recorded. Found: the search punched a protected peak wider than its box from the voxel beside it, since protected voxels dropped out of its local-maximum test (on 6/m test data, 198 of the 216 satellites in the grid punched with the points declared at ± 0.08, none with the planes; a first count, of 238, had taken 22 beyond the grid's edge), fixed in P4.15a; the bunching test still leaves out peaks within one grid step of a declared position. Found, not fixed (docs/modulation.md, known limits): measured_width_hkl reads maxima up to about 2.5 times the Bragg width as sharp (0.105 to 0.108 r.l.u. for σ of 0.04 to 0.1 r.l.u., where the line-cut FWHM reads 0.092 to 0.23). P2, behaviour-neutral, the web and the Pilot, in 4e060a3 and 6b170ea, with this entry: the Configure page declares the modulation in four fields (k, order, form, half width), which a run's request sends as `modulation`, never the legacy H fractions, and a form remembered before declarations has its legacy planes migrated once (an explicit value becomes k = (f, 0, 0) in plane form); the leftovers' marks, the punch's assessment and D5 read the run's own labels (GET /api/modulation/{id}/labels, from its record), never the form, and the TypeScript default and parseFractions are gone; assess_stage (the punch) and run_pipeline carry off_lattice_bunching {facts, ask_user} when the record's bunching fired, the question definition only in both arms and the facts' remedy span arm B's alone; the modulation is one sample setting behind the gate, its words provisional, the user's to confirm ("modulation", "wave vector", "propagation vector", a written k, and the protected planes' words; "satellites" alone names nothing); the answer checks unasked and assumed, each sent back once and then a note, pinned with known answers on both sides; the system prompt's sentence, the report's caveat, the validation's unsafe action and the skill lint's remap. On every dev case at n = 81 and n = 161, assess_stage (every stage, and the punch alone) and eight leftover scans are byte for byte as the base's, and the bunching test fires on none, so no dev run asks. P3, the behaviour change, in 6ff78cc (the default) and a70851c (the model's help and the console's words), with this entry: default_modulation() returns None, so a run that declares nothing protects nothing, records declared: null, and its bunching test reads every sharp peak the search found off the lattice; k = (1/3, 0, 0) declared as planes reproduces the old default bit for bit (the punched voxels and the peak records, on 6/m data and on satellites between a 0.05 r.l.u. grid's voxels); an undeclared thirds family on that grid is punched, all 200 satellites, and the punch names H ≡ ±1/3 (mod 1) and asks; the legacy request fields keep their meaning (the H fractions they name; a half width alone protects nothing, the default declaring none). On every dev case at n = 81 and n = 161 the punched volume, its holes, its peak records and its log are main's, and only the record's declared changes, to null: the search finds no peak off the lattice there, on the thirds or elsewhere, so it punches nothing more, and the bunching test fires on none. Arm A on dev run on 6ff78cc: 32 of 32 entries identical in score, detection and digest, 5 of 8 cases pass, as recorded; its log differs from the record only in the two lines main's does (dev-rings' R² -0.000 and 0.000, and dev-coverage's ring line, no_confirmed_rings with 18 not against no_rings with 0). The model's help for the setting says "default" declares none too (+6 characters; the token budget's guards hold: at 32k one skill gated at the cap leaves 893 past MIN_REPLY, at 57,344 both gated leave 7,324, where 3,072 must stay free). Left: the skill's fact sync and its words for the modulation (PR 2).

decision.option: nothing is protected by default; protection comes from a modulation k declared per material, as points or planes, the user's to declare; when sharp peaks off the lattice bunch at one commensurate fraction, the Pilot asks
